testcase.name: Scenario: Open and close the Sketch Constrain panel expansion: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:22:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and close the Sketch Constrain panel expansion ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Sketch ribbon is expanded and the Constrain panel is visible ✔ And the Constrain panel's additional command area is closed ✔ When the user opens the Constrain panel expansion ✔ Then an additional command area opens below the panel over the workspace ✔ And Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are visible ✔ And the sketch and model browser remain visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Constrain additional command area closes ✔ And the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
